subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: Should OpenClaw define a broad public trace-context contract for plugin hooks now, or split and limit the remaining observability fields to narrower hook families?
rationale: The remaining work is public Plugin SDK surface across lifecycle, message, compaction, reset, and subagent hooks, and the repository policy treats plugin API changes as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Define Additive Trace Contract
options.body: Sponsor a small design and implement narrow additive fields with documented optionality and tests for outbound, agent lifecycle, and subagent correlation.

options.title: Track Narrow Slices Only
options.body: Keep this broad issue open as context but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/18571 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80551 the first landing targets.

options.title: Defer Further Expansion
options.body: Document the current partial correlation guarantees and defer parent span/requester run semantics until a concrete plugin API proposal is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define Additive Trace Contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a small design and implement narrow additive fields with documented optionality and tests for outbound, agent lifecycle, and subagent correlation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent authored the merged trace carrier and hook correlation field slices most directly related to this decision.
